title: Ethics and Daily Dilemmas
subtitle: Dr. Imad & Dr. Soundous are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🏥

Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous are two passionate dentists. Every day, they treat patients, but also face ethical dilemmas.

Between a patient who refuses treatment, a colleague who prescribes incorrectly, a laboratory offering benefits, a publication on Instagram… complex situations are numerous.

The principles of non-maleficence, beneficence, patient autonomy, and loyalty are their compass.

A misjudgment, and patient trust is put at risk.

Ethics, the practitioner's credibility, and the practice's serenity rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous are two passionate dentists. Every day, they treat patients, but also face ethical dilemmas. They discover the fundamental principles of the Code of Ethics: non-maleficence, beneficence, patient autonomy, and loyalty between colleagues.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous deepen their knowledge of the legal and ethical aspects of the profession. They study the articles of the Code of Ethics, conflicts of interest, professional responsibilities, and applicable sanctions.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous face complex practical cases: minor patients, remote prescriptions, conflicts with colleagues, photo publication. They must master the management of ethical dilemmas to preserve patient trust.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous must manage ethical conflicts with colleagues, patient complaints, and crisis situations. They must defend ethical principles while respecting procedure and collegiality.
chapters.expert1: Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous become dental ethics references. They train young dentists in ethical reflection, participate in debates on ethical innovation, and contribute to the evolution of the profession.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and commitment, Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of ethical values and integrity to the dental profession. Ethics is the soul of the patient relationship.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous have laid the foundations of ethics. But the road is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: The legal aspects are mastered. Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous are ready to manage complex situations.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Daily dilemmas are successfully managed. Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Ethical conflicts are under control. Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Ethics has become a key skill. Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. Imad and Dr. Soundous have accomplished their mission. Ethics is the soul of the patient relationship.
